title: Premium Flax Seeds (Alsi) - 200 g
body_html:
Farmley is a dry-fruits & nuts specialist. We have built deep back-end linkages with 5000+ farmers & producers over the years, in order to provide adulteration free products. We blend health & taste in each new product that we curate by undergoing creative innovation and R&D. We are a full-stack brand offering 150+ products, bringing forth everything one can imagine under the umbrella of dry-fruits & nuts.

  • Good For Digestion: Flax seeds are an excellent source of both soluble and insoluble fiber. Insoluble fiber promotes the movement of material through your digestive system. It also promotes and maintains regularity and prevents constipation.
  • Source Of Protein: Protein is an important building block for bones, muscles, cartilage, and skin. Flaxseeds are a great source of high-quality, plant-based protein. One teaspoon of flax seeds contains nearly 2 grams of protein, and hence are a perfect alternative to animal protein sources. Adding them to a salad or smoothie can help boost your protein intake.
  • Helps Lower Cancer Risk: In addition to the important omega-3 fatty acids, they are known to prevent the development of cancerous tumours. Flax seeds are rich in lignans (a group of bioactive compounds that are chock-full of antioxidant properties) that may protect the body from cancer by slowing the growth of existing tumours.
  • Reduces Skin Inflammation: They also contain massive beauty benefits when applied directly to the skin. Because flaxseeds are high in anti-inflammatory omega-3s, they can help curb inflammation in the skin. Flax fiber has also been shown to have a healing effect on the skin.
  • Loaded With Nutrients: Flaxseed is particularly high in thiamine, a B vitamin that plays a key role in energy metabolism as well as cell function. It’s also a great source of copper, which is involved in brain development, immune health, and iron metabolism.

body_html:
Farmley is a dry-fruits & nuts specialist. We have built deep back-end linkages with 5000+ farmers & producers over the years, in order to provide adulteration free products.   • Immunity Booster: Immunity boosting effects of Sunflower Seeds are due to the presence of vitamin E, zinc & selenium in them. Vitamin E enhances immune responses and protects against several infectious diseases. It is also a powerful antioxidant & prevents free radicals from damaging healthy cells in your body. Zinc protects our body from inflammation, allergies & invading pathogens, thus preventing infections & increasing overall immunity.
  • Helps Regulate Cholesterol: The fiber content of Sunflower Seeds decreases levels of LDL cholesterol in the blood. Niacin or vitamin B3 present in Sunflower Seeds reduces total cholesterol levels and risk of heart diseases. Vitamin B5 or pantothenic acid increases HDL cholesterol & reduces total serum cholesterol levels.
  • Aids Weight Loss: Sunflower Seeds are rich in proteins & fiber. They make us feel full for a long time, reduce our food intake and finally reduce the number of calories consumed. This helps in reduction of weight.
  • A Powerhouse Of Energy: Sunflower Seeds are a good source of thiamine (vitamin B1). Thiamine helps to break down carbohydrates, proteins & fats present in our food into energy. They also help in muscle building. A handful of Sunflower Seeds can give you instant energy when consumed.
  • Good For The Skin: Sunflower Seeds have potent antibacterial activity. They help in effectively removing bacteria & germs from cells. They also help to flush out toxins from our body. Consuming Sunflower Seeds keeps your skin glowing. Antibacterial and antifungal activity of these seeds also prevents infections, thus keeping your skin clear. Oleic and linoleic acids help in the formation of collagen & elastin, speeding up wound healing. They also prevent the formation of scars.

title: Classic Salted Almonds (200g) - Roasted, Not Fried
body_html:
Our Roasted Almond Range is made from one of the best grades of Almonds. They are sourced from trusted farmers & producers, offering you the best quality & adulteration-free product. Seasoned with widely loved flavours, this range has been curated to make you savour a perfect blend of health and taste in each crunch.

- Adulteration Free: The complete roasting & flavouring process is carried out in our in-house processing units, ensuring that an adulteration free product is delivered.

- Roasted, Not Fried: Unlike the other snacking options, that are fried in Palm Oil, our Almonds are roasted & not fried.

- Loaded With Antioxidants: Almonds have a lot of antioxidants that can aid in the prevention of oxidative stress. They also play a significant role in anti-aging. The powerful antioxidants remain concentrated in the brown layer of the skin.

- Assist in Blood Sugar Management: Roasted almonds are rich in healthy fats, protein, and fiber while being low in carbohydrates. Almonds are rich in magnesium, making them an excellent alternative for diabetes patients. Magnesium intake also reduces insulin resistance in people who do not have diabetes. Furthermore, the magnesium in almonds may aid in the reduction of blood pressure. Low magnesium levels are connected to high blood pressure, implying that roasted almonds aid in controlling blood pressure.

- Lower Cholesterol Levels: A high level of LDL lipoproteins - known as bad cholesterol in your blood - is a well-known risk factor for heart disease. According to scientific research, roasted almonds may decrease LDL cholesterol. They do more than only reduce your blood LDL levels. They also protect LDL from oxidation, a crucial stage in the progression of heart disease. Taking one or two handfuls of roasted almonds can lower harmful cholesterol. And it may aid in reducing the risk of heart disease.

- Lowers Your Calorie Intake by Reducing Hunger: Roasted almonds are low in carbs but high in protein & fiber. Protein & fiber can boost feelings of satiety. It could also assist you in consuming fewer calories. According to scientific studies, a daily 1.5-ounce (43-gram) part of roasted almonds can lower hunger and the desire to eat.
